Title: Tiitoonde pijirlooji
Subtitle: Firo subtitles e ɗemngal Engele gila e PS5 maa e nder OBS.
ConnectHint: Ɓeydu binndol ngol e dingiral pijirlooji maa laawol gootol.
TestHint: Enndu doggol sample hade maa jokkondirde e konsol ngol.
SelectHint: Siftor kees e nder nate Engele e dow kaɓirgal pijirlooji.
AreaReady: Nokku tiitoonde ndee hisnaama. Uddit kamera virtuel OBS.
Help: Suɓo dingiral pijirlooji maa e nder OBS. Uddit Kuutorɗe → Binndanɗe e ɓuɗɗu +. Ɗaɓɓit laawol binndol ngol, udditaa fiilde ndee. Ɓoɗɗu butoŋ gonɗo e dottaaɗe binndol ngam ɓeydude nate e nder dingiral hee. Wartu e SubZir e ƴeewndo firo.
Checking: Janngude doggol sample e ƴeewtaade jokkorde OBS...
TestSuccess: OBS heɓi liggey sample. Ƴeewto darnde maggal e nder dingiral.
TestNoAck: Firo ngoo dañii, kono OBS tabitinaani ɗum. Suɓo nokku pijirlooji maa, mbaɗtu heen doggol 1 ngol.
Waiting: Eɗen ɗaminii binndanɗe e ɗemngal Engele ummoraade e kamera virtuel OBS...
OcrMissing: Sos anndinde binndi Engele e nder Windows. Ƴeew doggol ngol ngam heɓde jamirooje.
CheckCamera: Ƴeewto kamera wirto oo, cuɓo-ɗaa kadi nokku ɗo tiitoonde ndee woni ɗoo.
TestFailed: Test oo waawaa joofde. Uddit Caɗeele e nder doggol ngol.
TestEmpty: Alaa liggey sample keɓaa. Enndu jarribo ngoo kadi.
GettingFrame: Heɓde kaɓirgal e kamera wirto OBS...
NoFrame: Alaa kaɓirgal keɓaaɗo. E nder OBS, fuɗɗo kamera wirto oo, mbaɗtu heen 3.
Saved: Nokku hisnaama. Dobo e Fuɗɗoode firo.
LaunchError: Ittu ZIP oo fof e Documents, ƴeewto-ɗaa kadi.
Picker: Siftor kees e nder nokku oo ngam diidi tiitoonde wootere walla ɗiɗi
GuideBody: Softin binndanɗe Engele e nder pijirlooji maa. Jokkondir e kartal nanngugol e nder OBS. Ɓeydu binndol tiitoonde ndee e dingiral pijirlooji ɗii. Seto yaltinnde kamera wirto to iwdi kartal nanngugol e fuɗɗoraade kamera wirto. E nder SubZir, suɓo nokku ɗo tiitoonde ndee woni ɗoo, puɗɗo-ɗaa firo.
AddScene: Ɓeydu heen nate (subtitles) e dingiral jooni ngal
ModelError: Model firo oo waawaano timminde ɗaɓɓaande ndee. Ƴeew waktu dogdu/diagnostics.txt.
